game.simulate: SIMULATE THE REST OF THE GAME
game.tutorial: Safe hits more often and is worth less. Bold and reckless hit less and are worth more — they only pay off with high attributes. Your pick moves the game's margin and your points.
moment.openTone.label: 1Q · THE TONE
moment.openTone.s0: Tip-off done, first possession against the {opp}. The game has no shape yet — you decide the tone right away.
moment.openTone.s1: The {opp} come out scorching the nets on the first possessions. You feel the need to answer immediately.
moment.openTone.s2: Early minutes, the {opp} haven't found their rhythm yet. You've got the ball and the freedom to pick how you open the game.
moment.openTone.s3: The {opp}'s point guard tests you on the first switch. The answer can come on defense or on the scoreboard.
moment.openTone.s4: The {opp} are still settling on the floor. You can hold the pace or force the issue right away.
moment.q2tactic.label: Q2 · TACTICS
moment.q2tactic.s0: 2nd quarter: the {opp} clamp down on your side of the floor. The coach calls for a quick adjustment.
moment.q2tactic.s1: Pace flips — the {opp} bench unit presses and your offense loses its rhythm.
moment.q2tactic.s2: You feel the double team every time you touch the ball against the {opp}.
moment.q2tactic.s3: The {opp}'s defense packs the paint and opens up the three-point line. You can pull up from outside or force it inside.
moment.q2tactic.s4: The {opp} switch schemes midway through the second and their defense is still adjusting. The ball is in your hands.
moment.q3swing.label: 3Q · THE SWING
moment.q3swing.s0: Out of the half, the {opp} rip off a 9-0 run. The arena starts to turn.
moment.q3swing.s1: The {opp} flip the game on the back of their defense and won't give the ball up easy. You feel the pressure on both ends.
moment.q3swing.s2: The {opp} clog the paint and take away your space at the rim. The answer has to come from somewhere.
moment.q3swing.s3: Few minutes left in the third and the {opp} still haven't let go. The game calls for a heavyweight decision.
moment.q3swing.s4: The {opp} push the transition in the third and threaten to pull away. Someone needs to stop the bleeding.
moment.q4pressure.label: Q4 · PRESSURE
moment.q4pressure.s0: Start of the 4th: the {opp} go on a run and the lead evaporates fast.
moment.q4pressure.s1: Minutes are running out and the {opp} tighten up — every possession counts.
moment.q4pressure.s2: The pace cools off and the {opp} threaten to steal the game.
moment.q4pressure.s3: Bodies are heavy in the fourth and the {opp} feel it too. The decision could cost both sides.
moment.q4pressure.s4: The {opp} are in the bonus and every contact counts. You can hunt the line or push through the fatigue.
moment.clutch.label: 0:21 · CLUTCH
moment.clutch.s0: Final seconds, a tight game against the {opp}. The ball is yours.
moment.clutch.s1: Clock winding down, the {opp} won't give an inch. Decide now.
moment.clutch.s2: One point separates the teams against the {opp} — this moment is yours.
moment.clutch.s3: Seconds left and the {opp} are out of fouls to give. The decision decides the game.
moment.clutch.s4: The clock is running out on the {opp} and the defense won't give an inch. You choose how to close it out.
play.ambient.open.v0: Tip-off: the ball goes up between the fives and the game against the {opp} begins.
play.ambient.open.v1: Arena packed, crowd on its feet — the {opp} take the floor for the jump ball.
play.ambient.open.v2: Both sides feel each other out in the opening possessions against the {opp}.
play.ambient.0.v0: A studied start: defense dictates the game against the {opp}.
play.ambient.0.v1: A physical first quarter — the {opp} pressure the ball handler.
play.ambient.0.v2: The game opens fast-paced and the {opp} match it point for point.
play.ambient.1.v0: Bench rotation holds the pace before halftime.
play.ambient.1.v1: The {opp} string together a run and the arena heats up.
play.ambient.1.v2: Baskets trade back and forth in the second quarter — neither side pulls away.
play.ambient.2.v0: Out of the half with tightened defense on both ends.
play.ambient.2.v1: A choppy third quarter, heavy on fouls and short on space.
play.ambient.2.v2: The {opp} push the transition and force a timeout.
play.ambient.3.v0: Final quarter: every possession is a crime scene.
play.ambient.3.v1: The score tightens and the {opp} turn to a war of nerves.
play.ambient.3.v2: Down the stretch — the starters return and the game locks up.
play.feedHot.hit.v0: You find the hot hand in the corner — it drops.
play.feedHot.hit.v1: A masterful read: the assist lands in the right hands.
play.feedHot.miss.v0: The pass comes in too hot and turns into a turnover.
play.feedHot.miss.v1: The defense reads it and cuts off the passing lane.
play.takeOver.hit.v0: You take the game over: layup plus the foul.
play.takeOver.hit.v1: Isolation, crossover, and a bucket in the {opp}'s face.
play.takeOver.miss.v0: You force the drive and turn it over.
play.takeOver.miss.v1: The forced shot rims out twice.
play.lockDefense.hit.v0: The defense clogs the paint and forces the turnover.
play.lockDefense.hit.v1: A clean block on the {opp}'s drive.
play.lockDefense.miss.v0: The defensive switch fails and the {opp} score easily.
play.lockDefense.miss.v1: A silly foul sends the {opp} to the line.
play.pushPace.hit.v0: You push the pace and finish the fast break with a slam.
play.pushPace.hit.v1: Blistering tempo — the {opp} can't get back in time.
play.pushPace.miss.v0: The rush costs you: a pass sails out of bounds.
play.pushPace.miss.v1: You push the pace, slip, and the {opp} punish it on the break.
play.playHurt.hit.v0: Limping, you still jump the passing lane and score.
play.playHurt.hit.v1: Playing through it: a bucket on a compromised leg.
play.playHurt.miss.v0: The body doesn't respond — the shot comes up short.
play.playHurt.miss.v1: You push through the limit and the play dies on the rim.
play.safePass.hit.v0: A cold-blooded decision: the extra pass finds the open shot.
play.safePass.hit.v1: You draw two and find the open man — bucket.
play.safePass.miss.v0: The safe pass turns into a rushed shot at the buzzer.
play.safePass.miss.v1: The defense floats off and kills the safe option.
play.clutchThree.hit.v0: THREE AT THE BUZZER — the arena erupts.
play.clutchThree.hit.v1: Step-back three right in the defender's face.
play.clutchThree.miss.v1: An air ball on the game-winner.
play.attackRim.hit.v0: You tear through the paint and finish over the rim protector.
play.attackRim.hit.v1: A reckless drive — bucket and the foul at the buzzer.
play.attackRim.miss.v0: The {opp}'s rim protector meets you with a wall.
play.attackRim.miss.v1: You attack the rim and the block ends the play.
play.setTempo.hit.v0: You control the pace and find the open man — easy bucket.
play.setTempo.hit.v1: The ball moves calmly and the {opp} chase the play.
play.setTempo.miss.v0: The controlled pass comes in soft and the {opp} steal it.
play.setTempo.miss.v1: You hold the pace too long and the possession dies against the {opp}.
play.bodyUp.hit.v0: You body up and force the {opp} into a contested shot.
play.bodyUp.hit.v1: Tight coverage takes away the {opp}'s option and the possession ends in a miss.
play.bodyUp.miss.v0: The {opp} shrug off the coverage and score easily.
play.bodyUp.miss.v1: You lose the body battle and the {opp} finish uncontested.
play.firstStrike.hit.v0: You open the game with a bucket — first strike lands.
play.firstStrike.hit.v1: First possession, a three right in the {opp}'s face — splash.
play.firstStrike.miss.v0: The first strike misses the target and the {opp} run out.
play.firstStrike.miss.v1: You force it too early and the shot doesn't fall against the {opp}.
play.earlyIso.hit.v0: A sharp crossover and a layup in isolation against the {opp}.
play.earlyIso.hit.v1: You break your man down early and finish uncontested.
play.earlyIso.miss.v0: The handle slips and the {opp} steal it in isolation.
play.earlyIso.miss.v1: You force the early iso and lose your balance.
play.spaceFloor.hit.v0: You space the floor and knock it down wide open.
play.spaceFloor.hit.v1: Ball in the corner, the {opp} close out late and the net snaps.
play.spaceFloor.miss.v0: The open look clangs off the rim.
play.spaceFloor.miss.v1: You space the floor but the {opp} recover the coverage in time.
play.steadyShip.hit.v0: You hold the ball, organize the offense, and find the right shot.
play.steadyShip.hit.v1: A cold-blooded decision steadies the game against the {opp}.
play.steadyShip.miss.v0: Even playing it safe, the possession stalls and the {opp} capitalize.
play.steadyShip.miss.v1: You hold it too long and the shot clock punishes the team.
play.answerRun.hit.v0: You answer the run with a bomb right in the {opp}'s face.
play.answerRun.hit.v1: A bucket and the foul silence the {opp}'s crowd.
play.answerRun.miss.v0: The answer to the run misses and the {opp} keep rolling.
play.answerRun.miss.v1: You force the answer and the shot comes out too strong.
play.gambleSteal.hit.v0: Jumps the passing lane — steal and run-out.
play.gambleSteal.hit.v1: You read {opp} early and turn the miscue into an easy bucket.
play.gambleSteal.miss.v0: The gamble fails and {opp} gets a wide-open lane.
play.gambleSteal.miss.v1: You leave your feet and {opp} scores uncontested.
play.drawFoul.hit.v0: You attack the rim and hunt the contact — two shots coming.
play.drawFoul.hit.v1: A tough finish draws the whistle and you're at the line against the {opp}.
play.drawFoul.miss.v0: The ref lets it go and the {opp} come away with the ball.
play.drawFoul.miss.v1: You hunt the contact, but the whistle only calls the offensive foul.
play.isoClosing.hit.v0: Isolation to close it out — a crossover and a bucket in the {opp}'s face.
play.isoClosing.hit.v1: You close the game one-on-one and don't miss.
play.isoClosing.miss.v0: The closing isolation doesn't go as planned and the {opp} defend it well.
play.isoClosing.miss.v1: You try to close it alone and the {opp} double in time.
play.postSeal.hit.v0: You seal the post and finish over the {opp}.
play.postSeal.hit.v1: Body sealed, an easy layup closes the possession.
play.postSeal.miss.v0: The post seal fails and the {opp} steal the position.
play.postSeal.miss.v1: You try to seal it, but the {opp} push through and the ball squirts loose.
play.stepBack.hit.v0: A step-back at the buzzer — right in the {opp}'s face, no mercy.
play.stepBack.hit.v1: You create your own space and drain the game-winner.
play.stepBack.miss.v0: The step-back comes out contested and the ball doesn't fall.
play.stepBack.miss.v1: You force your own shot and the {opp} celebrate the miss.
